nodes.source_text: Ba8Ni6Ge40 precatalyst was further deposited on the low-cost, high surface area, and highly conductive nickel foam (Ba8Ni6Ge40/NF)

nodes.name: Electrochemical Reconstruction and Activation
nodes.procedure: The Ba8Ni6Ge40/FTO electrode underwent activation via 10 CV cycles followed by 24 h chronoamperometry at 1.55 V vs. RHE in 1.0 M KOH.

unit_operations.name: Chronoamperometry Reconstruction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: treated using 24 h chronoamperometry, CA, at 1.55 V vs. RHE

nodes.source_text: complete electrochemical transformation of Ba8Ni6Ge40... activation process was observed... treated using 24 h chronoamperometry, CA, at 1.55 V vs. RHE.

nodes.name: Electrochemical Reduction
nodes.procedure: The reconstructed NiOOH phase was reduced to Ni(OH)2 by applying a potential of 1.0 V vs. RHE for 24 hours.

unit_operations.name: Cathodic Reduction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: further 24 h of CA at the potential of 1.0 V versus RHE to reduce the sample

nodes.source_text: 24 h of CA at the potential of 1.0 V versus RHE to reduce the sample... most of the reconstructed NiOOH phase was reduced into Ni(OH)2

nodes.description: OER performance on FTO substrate in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: The electrocatalytic properties of Ba8Ni6Ge40/FTO were evaluated in a three-electrode setup in 1 M KOH... the electrochemically activated Ba8Ni6Ge40/FTO only required an overpotential of 321±2 mV at the current density of 10 mA cm-2... At 0.3 V overpotential (1.53 V vs. RHE), Ba8Ni6Ge40/FTO can afford ~50 mA mg-1 current density... Ba8Ni6Ge40/FTO has around 25 times higher redox activity per loaded nickel site than the Ni/FTO reference sample.

nodes.description: OER performance on Nickel Foam (NF) in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: Ba8Ni6Ge40/NF only required overpotentials of 227±2 and 319±2 mV at current densities of 10 and 100 mA cm-2, respectively... Ba8Ni6Ge40/NF also showed a Tafel slope as low as 47±1 mV dec-1.

nodes.description: Overall water splitting in an assembled two-electrode electrolyzer
nodes.source_text: As expected, the CA curve delivered a stable output of around 550 mA cm-2 for over 10 days at a cell voltage of 2.25 V (corresponding to an OER potential of ~1.718 V vs. RHE and HER potential of ~0.532 V vs. RHE)... the above-assembled electrolyzer can further deliver a significantly high current density of ~880 mA cm-2 at a cell voltage of 2.2 V at an industrially relevant operation temperature (80°C).

nodes.description: Alkaline HER performance on nickel foam
nodes.source_text: Note that the Ba8Ni6Ge40/NF displays a moderate alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) (Figure S37).

nodes.characterization_summary: PXRD and Rietveld refinement confirmed the synthesis of pure Ba8Ni6Ge40 in the cubic space group Pm-3n with a lattice parameter of a = 10.6754(5) Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Rietveld refinement of the powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) pattern of the as-prepared sample (Figure 1a and Table S1) shows that we successfully synthesized pure Ba8Ni6Ge40 which crystallized in the cubic space group Pm-3n with a lattice parameter of a = 10.6754(5) Å.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES indicates metallic Ni character. EXAFS analysis confirmed the clathrate structure with Ni-Ge (2.29 Å), Ni-Ba (3.92 Å), and Ni-Ge (3.98 Å) coordination environments.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni K-edge X-ray absorption nearedge structure (XANES) of Ba8Ni6Ge40 strongly indicates a metallic Ni-like character ... EXAFS analysis of Ni species confirmed the clathrate structure ... with bond distances of 2.29, 3.92, and 3.98 Å

nodes.evidence_snippet: the morphology of bulk Ba8Ni6Ge40 powder deposited on FTO substrate was analyzed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) ... the particles exhibiting a pseudosphere-like morphology mainly distributed in the range from 0.2 to 3 μm

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM, HRTEM, and SAED confirm the pseudosphere morphology and crystalline structure of the fresh clathrate phase.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM image of the powder sample scratched off from the FTO also revealed the pseudosphere-like morphology ... diffraction rings in the selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern could be well indexed as the lattice planes of the Ba8Ni6Ge40 phase ... HRTEM image demonstrated the crystal structure of Ba8Ni6Ge40

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP analysis revealed an atomic ratio of 1.6:1:8.4 for Ba, Ni, and Ge, consistent with the theoretical clathrate formula.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the inductively coupled plasma (ICP) also revealed the atomic ratio of 1.6:1:8.4 among Ba, Ni, and Ge, which closely approximated the theoretical ratio.

nodes.characterization_summary: Post-OER PXRD showed complete disappearance of clathrate peaks, leaving only the FTO substrate signals, indicating deep reconstruction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The post-CA PXRD pattern for the Ba8Ni6Ge40/FTO displayed only diffraction peaks attributable to the FTO substrate, implying the complete reconstruction of the Ba8Ni6Ge40/ precatalyst

nodes.characterization_summary: Post-OER XPS shows the conversion of Ni to Ni(III) (suggesting NiOOH) and the oxidative leaching of Ba and Ge.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution XPS spectra of Ni 2p indicated the conversion of all Ni species to NiIII ... spectra of Ba 3d and Ge 3d also displayed an oxidative leaching trend

nodes.characterization_summary: Post-OER TEM and HRTEM reveal a flowerlike nanosheet architecture composed of porous and defective gamma-NiOOH nanocrystals (~5 nm).
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM (recorded from different angles) images illustrated the transformation from pseudosphere-like morphology to a flowerlike architecture assembled by nanosheets ... HRTEM image depicted a number of gamma -NiOOH nanocrystals with an average size of around 5 nm , which were interconnected to form porous and defective nanosheets
